officialEvidence.title: Version
officialEvidence.claim: V8.2 is the current default and uses the Edit Model instead of Omni Reference.

officialEvidence.title: Parameter List
officialEvidence.claim: Parameters follow prompt text, use one preceding space, and contain no punctuation in the parameter section.

officialEvidence.title: Style Reference
officialEvidence.claim: Style Reference is supported in V6 and later; text should describe target content without conflicting style instructions.

officialEvidence.title: Seeds
officialEvidence.claim: A seed can hold short-session experiment noise but is not a style or identity bookmark.

compatibilityChecks.message: The exact LicenseProfile reference records a resolved external-use rights gate for this structure-only fixture.
The plan pins V8.2 on the web surface.
Every parameter is structured once and rendered after the prompt body without punctuation.
The binding uses a V6+ Style Reference and does not use V7-only Omni Reference.
The V8.2 prompt contains no unsupported multi-prompt separator or numeric text weight.
The seed is limited to a short-session one-variable comparison and is not treated as identity or style evidence.

steps: Select V8.2 on the Midjourney web surface.
Confirm every hidden default below before submission.
Attach REF_STYLE_CORRIDOR_MATERIAL_01 only in the Style Reference slot.
Verify that the exact referenced LicenseProfile remains approved for this external use.
Paste the baseline copyText exactly and submit manually.
Run the stylize-250 variant only after preserving the baseline result and metadata.
Return original files and exact metadata; do not report a planned or submitted job as a successful image.

hiddenDefaultChecks.expectedState: off unless a separately recorded profile binding is approved
0 unless explicitly added as the one changed variable

requiredItems.description: The exact Midjourney job/task identifier and creation timestamp.
The model version and surface shown for the completed external job.
The exact submitted text plus any provider-resolved prompt or code form.
Actual parameters, automatic rewrites, aspect ratio, dimensions, Raw state, stylize, variety, quality, weird, and seed when present.
The type, count, and stable user-side identifier of each attached reference without credentials or expiring private URLs.
Original downloaded files, filenames, and hashes computed only after the files are locally available.
Any moderation block, incompatibility, provider warning, failed variant, or automatic rewrite.
The exact baseline or one-variable variant associated with each returned output.
